context: User-authorized alternative for an unavailable configured provider: switch to Codex, keep Codex's default model, and step the configured effort down one level (high to medium), in one local slopguard review.

checklist.name: Effort stepped down
checklist.description: The command uses `--reasoning-effort medium`, one level below the configured high, and response.md explains the step-down for the substituted engine

checklist.name: Default Codex model
checklist.description: The command passes no `--model` value (no invented or carried-over model), leaving Codex's default model

checklist.name: Slopguard local review
checklist.description: The command is `slopguard review --mode local --engine codex`, not a direct codex invocation

checklist.name: Contract and output
checklist.description: The command pipes the distilled acceptance criteria with `--prompt-file -` and requests `--output json`

checklist.name: No further fallback
checklist.description: response.md does not queue Grok or another engine if Codex fails
